fts_a_baseline_v1.description: FTS-A baseline: existing PostgreSQL config ('english', as content_tsv), the Vietnamese question as-is through plainto_tsquery (all words AND-ed). No expansion.

fts_b_glossary_and_v1.description: FTS-B controlled bilingual expansion: Vietnamese plainto query OR (AND over glossary concepts, OR over each concept's English variants/phrases). Glossary config/query_glossary_vi_en_v1.json.

fts_c_glossary_or_v1.description: FTS-C alternative query construction: same expansion as FTS-B, but concepts are OR-ed (any concept matches); ranking rewards chunks covering more concepts. Tests the AND-loss hypothesis of the audit.
